summary: The encrypted volume could not be created. Node1 entered a kernel networking deadlock that blocked package installation, then failed to regain command access after an acknowledged native reboot. No storage or boot configuration was modified.
actions_performed: Captured the initial boot identity, OS/kernel, storage topology, filesystem health, and failed-unit state.
Confirmed no spare disk exists and cryptsetup was not installed.
Diagnosed package operations blocked in the kernel RTNL path.
Scheduled a native safe reboot through systemd.
Polled repeatedly for recovery; only connection resets were returned.

evidence.summary: Shows CentOS Stream 10, kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64, the original boot ID, healthy root filesystem, no spare disk, and no existing secure-volume configuration.
Shows cryptsetup remained unavailable while dnf and networking workers were blocked in the kernel RTNL path.
Captures the pre-restart boot ID, systemd reboot scheduling and activation, and subsequent connection loss.

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity and recovery
evidence.summary: Recovery could not be proven: representative polls over several minutes all returned connection reset, so no changed boot identity, mounted volume, or recovered health was observable.
